motions.item_title: Approve the May 15, 2018, and March 5, 2019, Redevelopment Agency Board Meeting minutes. Board…
motions.motion: Board Member Gricius moved to approve the May 15, 2018, and March 5, 2019, Redevelopment Agency Board Meeting minutes. Board Member Clark seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Cufus, Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Reaves, Donna Burnham, and Melissa Clarlc The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Two sets of old minutes approved
motions.summary: The agency board approved its minutes from May 15, 2018 and March 5, 2019.
motions.impact: Close to a year of unapproved records was cleared in one go. It touches the file cabinet and no household.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah adopting an Offic…
motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah adopting an Official Project Area Plan for the Pole Canyon Community Reinvestment Project Area. Board Member Curtis seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Reaves, Donna Burnham, and Melissa Clark The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Tax increment plan for 80 acres at Pole Canyon
motions.summary: The agency adopted the official plan for the Pole Canyon project area, 80 acres of industrial-planned land where tax increment can pay for development.
motions.impact: The site sits in the Pole Canyon master plan and is aimed at industry, with a food manufacturing business under discussion. A resident who spoke raised traffic and the two roads planned there.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency adopting the Project Area Budge…
motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved to approve a resolution of the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency adopting the Project Area Budget for the Pole Canyon Community Reinvestment Project Area. Board Member Reaves seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Reaves, Donna Burnham, Melissa Clarlc The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Pole Canyon project budget adopted
motions.summary: The agency adopted the spending plan for the Pole Canyon project area, setting where its tax increment revenue comes from and what it may be spent on.
motions.impact: This is the money side of the Pole Canyon deal, with a cost-benefit analysis putting the city's benefit at about $3 million. A tenth of the increment is set aside for affordable housing.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting the ten…
motions.motion: Board Member Curtis moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting the tentative budget for Fiscal Year 2019-2020 and setting a public hearing for adoption of the Jinal budget on May 21, 2019. Board Member Clark seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Reaves, Donna Burnham, and Melissa Clarlc The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Draft 2019-20 agency budget and May 21 hearing
motions.summary: The agency board adopted a tentative budget for the 2019-2020 year and set a May 21, 2019 public hearing before the final budget is adopted.
motions.impact: Nothing is locked in at this stage. If you wanted a say on the agency's spending, May 21 was the date to speak.

Board Member Clark seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency Meeting - May 7,2019 Page 3 of5 Reaves, Donna Burnham, and Melissa Clarlc The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: City signs its own Pole Canyon tax agreement
motions.summary: The agency and Eagle Mountain City agreed on how the city will collect and remit the property tax growth from land inside the Pole Canyon project area.
motions.impact: Both sides of this deal are the same five people, sitting once as the council and once as the agency board. Your city tax bill is untouched; the city's share of new Pole Canyon revenue is what moves.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, approving an in…
motions.motion: Board Member Reaves moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, approving an interlocal cooperation agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Utah County for the collection and remittance of incremental property taxes collected from properQ within the Pole Canyon Community Reinvestment Area. Board Member Clark seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Reaves, Donna Burnham, and Melissa Clark The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Utah County signs Pole Canyon tax agreement
motions.summary: The agency board approved the Utah County version of the Pole Canyon agreement, covering collection and remittance of property tax growth from the project area.
motions.impact: County services carry on as before, and no household pays anything new. This is the county's signature on the tax sharing that funds the Pole Canyon project.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, approving an int…
motions.motion: Board Member Curtis moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, approving an interlocal cooperation agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Alpine School District for the collection and remittance of incremental propefi taxes collected from property within the Pole Canyon Community Reinvestment Area- Board Member Clark seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Reaves, Donna Burnham, and Melissa Clarlc The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: School district signs Pole Canyon tax agreement
motions.summary: The agency approved an agreement with Alpine School District for collecting and remitting the property tax growth generated inside the Pole Canyon project area.
motions.impact: Classrooms and school budgets keep running on the taxes already collected there. The share of future growth on that land is what this document commits, and it takes years to arrive.

motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency oi Eagle Mountain City, Utah, approving an interlocal cooperation agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Central Utah Water Conservancy Districtfor the collection and remittance of incremental property taxes collected .from property within the Pole Canyon Community Reinvestment Area. Board Member Gricius seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency Meeting - May 7,2019 Page 4 of 5 Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Reaves, Donna Burnham, and Melissa Clark The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Water district signs on to Pole Canyon increment
motions.summary: The agency signed a matching agreement with the Central Utah Water Conservancy District covering collection and remittance of property tax growth inside the Pole Canyon project area.
motions.impact: Your water bill is not part of this arrangement. What the district signed governs how the tax growth from the Pole Canyon land is handed back for use in the project.

Board Member Gricius seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Stephanie Gricius, Benjamin Reaves, Donna Burnham, and Melissa Clarlc The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Fire district joins Pole Canyon tax deal
motions.summary: The agency board signed an agreement with the Unified Fire Service Area to collect and pass on property tax growth from the Pole Canyon project area.
motions.impact: Fire coverage where you live is not altered by this. The agreement sets the route by which the fire district's share of new Pole Canyon tax revenue reaches the agency.
